## Activity

During April 2024, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 421 captures. This provides the activity total for the month and reflects the number of captures entered into the site operations record. The activity is reported for Harbour Eye Clinic only and relates to April 2024.

## Image quality

Of the captures recorded, 16 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.8 per cent. These figures are presented together to show both the number of ungradable captures and their proportion of the monthly activity. Image quality performance for the month is therefore recorded using 16 ungradable captures and an ungradable rate of 3.8.

## Grading

Grading identified 126 referable results during April 2024. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This records the central grading interval for the month alongside the number of referable results. The grading summary for Harbour Eye Clinic is 126 referable results, with a median lag of 2.
